sources.scope: Printed pp. 12-17/PDF pp. 15-20: 67 original creature qualities. Printed pp. 18-23/PDF pp. 21-26: definitions. Guide pre-dates expansions; discrepancies are retained in sources.md.

changesToPriorUnappliedCandidate: Toughness English label and factual effect; Strength factual effect; both classified Passive.
Generalize creature-specific resistance and other variable values in shared descriptions.
Remove supplied physical PK fields from detail additions.
guideDiscrepancies: Bone Dragon uses the guide label Terror; wiki distinguishes Fear from Nightmare Terror. Existing separate candidate identities retained.
Phoenix guide lists Fire Attack, while wiki lists Fire Resistance. Candidate retains Fire Resistance; guide is not credited for that link.
Guide contains an early statistics snapshot and several typesetting anomalies; it is not used to overwrite combat statistics.
